subject: Matemática
description_pt: Associar figuras geométricas espaciais (cubo, bloco retangular, pirâmide, cone, cilindro e esfera) a objetos do mundo físico e nomear essas figuras.

components.description_pt: Identificar figuras geométricas tridimensionais por nome, incluindo cubo, paralelepípedo, pirâmide, cone, cilindro e esfera
components.description_en: Identify three-dimensional geometric figures by name, including cube, rectangular prism, pyramid, cone, cylinder, and sphere

components.description_pt: Associar objetos do mundo real com suas correspondentes figuras geométricas tridimensionais
components.description_en: Associate real-world objects with their corresponding three-dimensional geometric figures

components.description_pt: Distinguir cubo, paralelepípedo, pirâmide, cone, cilindro e esfera por suas propriedades visuais
components.description_en: Distinguish among cube, rectangular prism, pyramid, cone, cylinder, and sphere by their visual properties
components.cc_component_description: Use geometric shapes, their measures, and their properties to describe objects

cc_matches.description: Use geometric shapes, their measures, and their properties to describe objects (e.g., modeling a tree trunk or a human torso as a cylinder).
